mapper.select: SELECT cr.id, cr.card_id, cr.source_key, cr.used_date, cr.used_time, cr.store_name, cr.used_amount, cr.payment_type, cr.installment_month, cr.approval_no, cr.payment_due_date, cr.domestic_foreign_type, cr.store_corp_no, cr.store_type, cr.store_no, cr.cancel_status, cr.cancel_amount, cr.vat, cr.cash_back, cr.krw_amount, cr.currency, cr.raw_data, cr.created_at FROM card_record cr JOIN card c ON c.id = cr.card_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND ( #{lastSyncAt} IS NULL OR cr.created_at > #{lastSyncAt} ) ORDER BY cr.created_at, cr.id
